_what_this_is: One agent's behaviour policy read as an insurance policy, with a vendor's layer on each row. Every number is illustrative, chosen to show the shape of the formula; none is fitted to loss data.
agent: a support agent connected to the customer database (the Licence to Operate vault's agent:concierge, generalised)

rows.vendor_note: The customer gave the agent write access; the vendor's product did what it was allowed to do.
A leak through the vendor's own output filter, with the filter switched on, is partly the vendor's.

rows.risk: Wrong answer acted on by a customer
rows.vendor_note: The answer is the vendor's product; half of this row is the vendor's when its guardrails were on.
No limit named: excluded for everyone.

controls.control: At most 20 customer records per action
controls.enforced_by: a proxy in front of the CRM

controls.control: Outbound network only to an allow list
Answers with a refund or a legal point go to a person
controls.enforced_by: a hook that holds the reply
